title: BlockMember
description:
A peaceful and friendly public welfare Minecraft vanilla survival server. SMP server
一个祥和友好的公益MineCraft原版生存服务器。SMP Server
body:
BlockMember 致力于打造一个祥和友好的公益MineCraft原版生存服务器。

在这里，你可以带上你的朋友独创小镇，或加入别人小镇，亦或者是独狼生存等等......只要在不违规的情况下，都可以在这畅快游玩。

无论你是建筑大佬，生电玩家，休闲玩家，社交玩家等等。强劲的13600KF将承托起这一份珍贵的世界和玩家们的愿想。

为了适应多人的服务器玩法。我们对原版的一些机制做了轻微的更改。

希望在BlockMember里游玩的经历，能成为你的珍贵回忆。

官网：www.blockmember.org
审核群：970297553

BlockMember is dedicated to creating a peaceful and friendly non-profit Minecraft vanilla survival server.

Here, you can bring your friends to build your own town, join someone else's town, or go solo... as long as you follow the rules, you can enjoy the game freely here.

Whether you're a master builder, a redstone enthusiast, a casual player, or a social butterfly... the powerful 13600KF processor is here to support this precious world and the dreams of its players.

To adapt to the multiplayer server experience, we’ve made some slight adjustments to the original mechanics.

We hope your time at BlockMember becomes a cherished memory.

Website: www.blockmember.org
